text.en: A bright, wine-free lentil filling capped with olive-oil potato and little green pools of parsley. A brisk, lighter pad thai with juicy prawns, heaps of sprouts and a sharp lime-forward sauce. A generous plate of sumac chicken, golden bulgur, salad and cooling yogurt made with halal-compatible ingredients. A glossy, unabashed bowl of butter, parmesan and black pepper clinging to long ribbons of pasta. A pantry-friendly tomato soup rounded with cream, basil and a tiny lick of smoked paprika. A rainy-afternoon soup with blistered tomatoes, roasted garlic, basil oil and crisp parmesan crumbs. All the warm spice and cool garlic sauce of döner, built over crunchy greens instead of bread. Arugula Balsamic vinegar Bean sprouts Black pepper Brown lentils Bulgur Butter Canned tomatoes Cannellini beans Carrot Cashew cream, mellow white miso and lemon make a quietly savory sauce with proper pasta-water gloss. Cashews Cauliflower Celery stalk Charred shawarma-spiced tofu, lemony tahini and a tumble of herbs in a thin toasted flatbread. Chewy rice noodles lacquered with tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar, tossed with chicken and crisp bean sprouts. Chicken breast Chicken stock Chicken thigh Chickpea Cloud Shakshuka Chickpea flour Chickpeas Chili flakes Corn-rice fettuccine in a bright parmesan cream, balanced with lemon zest and peppery greens. Cornstarch Creamy without cream: white beans disappear into tomato and leave behind body, protein and a soft ivory swirl.
